defects.title: KitchenOperationsStore reads catalog.categories via raw SQL bypassing module boundary
defects.invariant: Module boundaries: Kitchen module must not directly read Catalog tables; catalog data must be accessed via Catalog module's API/repository
defects.mechanism: KitchenOperationsStore.GetCategoriesAsync() at line 348 executes raw SQL "SELECT category_id, name FROM catalog.categories WHERE active ORDER BY sort_order, name" directly against the catalog.categories table. This is a cross-module table read without going through the Catalog module's PostgresCategoryRepository (which owns catalog.categories at line 7 of PostgresCategoryRepository.cs). The comment at line 340-343 acknowledges this but claims it's acceptable because 'a category NAME is not a catalog-management decision' - however this rationalization does not restore the module boundary.
defects.acceptance: KitchenOperationsStore.GetCategoriesAsync must be removed or refactored to call a Catalog module query endpoint/repository instead of raw SQL. A test must verify Kitchen module no longer directly queries catalog.categories.

limitations: The defect is confirmed by source code inspection. The raw SQL read is present and active in HEAD. No evidence of a Catalog module query API being used instead. The comment rationalizing the boundary violation is part of the defect - it documents the known bypass.
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
